أعلول (form XII)
# أَعْلَوْلِ (ʔaʕlawli) /ʔaʕ.law.li/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# أُعْلَوْلَ (ʔuʕlawla) /ʔuʕ.law.la/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
